name: Market Sentiment Bot
tagline: Grades US risk assets one to ten, with a card for the market and each ticker
description: Puts a one-to-ten score on US risk assets and shows it two ways: an overall market card, and per-ticker views spanning macro conditions, geopolitics, oil, liquidity and earnings. Everything it reads is public web data, and it stops at scoring. No orders are placed and no brokerage is involved.
author: Itachidata
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
